author.personaname: Why is the cart not Moo?

reviews.review: I was actually pleasantly surprised by this one! I saw the reviews were mixed so I was very skeptical especially with it being an SCP game. But this is actually kind of fun. It has just the right amount of jank to be charming, it kind of gives a sort of early Resident Evil game feel. The aiming is a bit rough, especially since the enemies need headshots to kill, but that is a bit of a skill issue I wont lie. After my first run I got the hang of it. Then its just down to learning how the enemies behave and adjust yourself from there. The main chase theme of this game also goes much harder than it should. Its so good. And the opening cutscene just puts it all together perfectly. This is one of those diamonds in the rough. Yeah its basic, yeah its janky and I love everything about it. Plus bonus points for not using AI voice acting. This game really doesnt deserve the hate, especially since its free.
